summary:
I wrote $HOME/projects/llm/llamacpp/models.md, about 490 lines, with the Write tool. No other file was touched; scratch reads went into the scratchpad's live/ folder.

What it contains:
- The summary, then an at-a-glance table covering all 10 ranked picks: GGUF, size, --n-cpu-moe, context, KV type, estimated GPU and RAM use, and the memory cap.
- Shared rules for every recipe, mostly as links to llamacpp/README.md.
- One recipe card for each pick, in the order of the updated ranking: Qwen3.8-27B, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, K2 Horizon MoVA, K2 Horizon 7B, Gemma 4 26B-A4B, Qwen3-Coder-Next, Nemotron 3.5 Bolt, Groot, gpt-oss-20b and DeepSeek-R1-0528-Qwen3-8B. Each card has:
  - the exact repo, file name and byte size;
  - a full docker run command: GGML_CUDA_DISABLE_GRAPHS=1 before the image, port on 127.0.0.1 only, equal --memory and --memory-swap, the HF cache mount, no restart policy, --alias local;
  - the memory and context arithmetic, labelled estimate or inferred;
  - sampling from the model card or Unsloth, thinking control, the tool-call parser and open issues;
  - an Ollama alternative and evidence links.
- A Gemma 4 A/B subsection comparing Google's QAT Q4_0 with Unsloth's QAT UD-Q4_K_XL.
- Short fallback and trial cards for Nemotron Lightning, GLM-4.7-Flash and Nanbeige (blocked until PR #31986 ships).
- A table of rejected GGUF options, a first-run checklist, Sources and Maintenance.

Corrections applied:
- Audit fixes are applied, including -e placement, --n-cpu-moe counting from block 0, and the reason for the image choice.
- The Qwen3.6 card sampling follows the corrected card three-way split.
- The Gemma 64k context is q8_0-only, with headroom of 79k-129k.
- The Unsloth review check is applied: Qwen3.8 UD-Q3_K_XL was replaced with a UD3.1 build on 2026-11-12 at the same size.
- MoVA uses --n-cpu-moe 46 rather than 44.
- force_nonempty_content is dropped for Lightning.

Checked live on 2026-11-15:
- All GGUF file names and byte sizes, via the HF tree API, and that none of these repos is gated.
- These flags exist in b12407 arg.cpp: --hf-file, --reasoning-effort, --cache-ram, --presence-penalty, --min-p, --alias, --override-kv and --no-mmproj. -hf falls back to the first file when Q4_K_M is missing, so the Bolt, Gemma and Lightning commands use --hf-file.
- Issue states: #30781, #31974 and #29947 are open; #30246 closed 2026-11-12; #30490 closed 2026-10-26; PR #31986 open.
- The gpt-oss-120b MXFP4 size: 59.03 GiB.
- The AA page URLs.

Memory-cap choices that differ from the ranking:
- Full-GPU models get 16g.
- Qwen3.6 gets 20g, matching README.md. The ranking says about 16g, but the 8 GiB default prompt cache has to fit too.
- Bolt gets 20g instead of 16g.
- MoVA gets 24g with --cache-ram 4096.
- Coder-Next gets 32g with --cache-ram 2048.
Each cap is explained by the formula: experts in RAM plus prompt cache plus process.

One inconsistency remains between sibling documents: docs/host-setup.md suggests about 14g for Qwen3.6 and 8g for full-GPU models.
unverified: Every VRAM, RAM, context and tok/s figure is arithmetic from GGUF headers and configs in the research records; compute-buffer and CUDA-context sizes (0.4 GiB context, 0.5-1.5 GiB compute) are assumptions, nothing was run on the laptop.
Memory caps (16g/20g/24g/32g) are my estimates from experts-in-RAM plus --cache-ram plus 2-3 GiB process overhead; not measured.
Qwen3.6 general-thinking presence_penalty: the model card (per the facts check) says 1.5, Unsloth says 0.0; I cited the card without re-reading it live.
Unsloth's Gemma 4 KLD comparison (Q4_0 14.44 GB) most likely refers to Google's QAT GGUF, but the page does not name the repo (inferred from the size match).
Whether llama.cpp #30781 (gpt-oss array params without items) affects gpt-oss-20b with OpenCode tool schemas.
Whether the fix for closed issue #30490 (LFM2.5 tool calls lost as content) is in b12407.
Whether the official IFM K2 Horizon GGUFs (uploaded before mainline support) load in b12407, and whether the bartowski K2 7B GGUF carries post-FTPO weights (inferred from upload dates).
Groot: the community reports of altered verbatim path text, and whether #30118 and #30357 reproduce on it.
The DeepSeek Unsloth GGUF template injecting a tool list, and llama.cpp lacking a dedicated R1 tool handler, come from the research records; not re-read live.
Artificial Analysis, NVIDIA and vendor scores, plus Ollama tag sizes and digests, were taken from the verified records and the ranking; only page reachability was checked live, not the numbers.
Whether -hf with only a repo plus --hf-file resolves the intended file in b12407 (flag semantics read from arg.cpp; not executed).
Whether -lm none puts the experts in anonymous memory that counts against the container cap: taken from benchmarking.md, not verified in the source.
The Bolt LiLiCorr drafter benefit and the CPU-side IQ2_XXS decode cost are unmeasured.
